block.create_transit.transit_gate.toolti: Handles _customs_ for arriving shipments, stripping _one transit label_ and merging a declared order back into a single delivery.
block.create_transit.transit_link.toolti: Declares a _border_ on this network. Every shipment it forwards is stamped with its _transit label_.
block.create_transit.transit_ticker.tool: Mounts a _second logistics network_ onto this one, so its _stock_ can serve requests made here.
create_transit.package_port.endpoint_off: The address is an ordinary local one
create_transit.package_port.endpoint_on: The address is a foreign package's transit label (blank = default lane, * = any)
create_transit.schedule.instruction.time: The exact station name of this train's own bay
create_transit.timetable.bind_first: Set a parking bay first: right-click its train station
create_transit.timetable.bind_hint: Right-click a train station to set the parking bay
create_transit.timetable.needs_conductor: Transit duty needs a conductor at both ends
create_transit.transit_gate.goggles.adop: Transit label adopted from the sign at %s, %s, %s
create_transit.transit_gate.goggles.any: Strips any transit label from passing packages; stamps none on departure
create_transit.transit_gate.goggles.stri: Strips the %s transit label from passing packages
create_transit.transit_gate.goggles.wild: No sign: strips any transit label, stamps the default lane on departure
create_transit.transit_link.goggles.disa: Disabled: no transit label, so this link declares no border
create_transit.transit_link.label_hint: Names the border gate shipments clear at
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.cy: Warning: proxy cycle detected, contributing empty stock
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.di: Child network not reachable (unbound or unloaded)
create_transit.transit_ticker.goggles.mo: Warning: a Stock Link and a Transit Link are both mounted; transit requests are starved
item.create_transit.transit_timetable.to: _Donates_ a train to the network: bind its _parking bay_, then hand this to a _conductor_. The dispatcher does the rest.
